title: The oil rig that drained a lake
caption:
One wrong drill hole, and a whole lake went down the plughole. 🕳️
Water dissolved the salt mine's pillars, which widened the hole, which let in more water: a runaway loop that drained Lake Peigneur in hours.
Would you have stayed on the boat?
sources: Wikipedia, Lake Peigneur (20 November 1980; Texaco drill punctured the Diamond Crystal salt mine; all 55 miners escaped; 11 barges and the drilling rig lost; the Delcambre Canal reversed into a waterfall; the lake refilled with salt water)
